Video Title: Not every landlord should switch to Airbnb
Script:
Not every property owner should put their property on Airbnb. 

Why. Well, you need 3 things: DRO
1. Strong local demand
2. Rules                                      
3. Operations to take care of it

Ask three things: is there genuine local demand, do the lease and rules allow it, and do you want the work involved? If one answer is no, a traditional let may be better. Airbnb is a business model, not a magic upgrade. Save this before switching.
Visual Elements: Close-up talking head outside a rental. On-screen title: ‘Not every landlord should switch to Airbnb’. Cut to three numbered cards: Demand, Rules, Operations. End on a calm exterior shot.

Video Title: The Airbnb income number that misleads landlords
Script:
Nightly rate can be the most misleading number in Airbnb. 

£180 a night is not automatically better than £120. You must account for cleaning, utilities, maintenance, fees and your time.
Visual Elements: Talking head with title: ‘£180 a night can still be a bad deal’. Overlay a simple calculator: rate minus occupancy, cleaning, utilities and fees. Use B-roll of cleaning and a guest-ready room.
